endpoints.name: Activity Sets
endpoints.description: The templates that create a standard batch of tasks and events at once -- Insightly's repeatable process definitions. What a team considers its standard procedure.

endpoints.name: Activity Set
endpoints.description: One activity set by id, with its tasks and events.

endpoints.name: Comment File Attachments
endpoints.description: The files attached to one comment. Requires a comment id.

endpoints.name: Contacts
endpoints.description: The people in the CRM, with name, contact details, the organisation, owner, tags, dates and custom fields. THE PATTERN OF THIS CONNECTOR, which repeats for every major object: a plain listing, a Search variant taking field criteria, a SearchByTag variant, and a family of child endpoints for that record's emails, events, notes, tasks, links, files and follow state. Once one object is understood the rest follow the same shape.

endpoints.name: Contact
endpoints.description: One contact by id.

endpoints.name: Contact Emails
endpoints.description: The emails linked to one contact. Requires a contact id.

endpoints.name: Contact Events
endpoints.description: The calendar events involving one contact. Requires a contact id.

endpoints.name: Contact File Attachments
endpoints.description: The files attached to one contact. Requires a contact id.

endpoints.name: Contact Follow State
endpoints.description: Whether the calling user follows one contact. Scoped to the caller.

endpoints.name: Contact Links
endpoints.description: The other records one contact is linked to -- organisations, opportunities, projects. Requires a contact id. LINKS ARE HOW INSIGHTLY MODELS RELATIONSHIPS: a contact carries one organisation id, but everything else it relates to is expressed here, so the object graph is only traversable through the link endpoints.

endpoints.name: Contact Notes
endpoints.description: The notes on one contact. Requires a contact id.

endpoints.name: Contact Tasks
endpoints.description: The tasks relating to one contact. Requires a contact id.

endpoints.name: Filtered Contacts
endpoints.description: Contacts matching field criteria. The filtered route where the plain listing only pages.

endpoints.name: Filtered Contacts by Tag
endpoints.description: Contacts carrying a given tag. Tags are Insightly's cross-cutting segmentation, so this is often the fastest way to a business-meaningful subset.

endpoints.name: Countries
endpoints.description: The country list Insightly recognises. Reference data.

endpoints.name: Currencies
endpoints.description: The currencies configured, with their codes. Opportunity values are held in their own currency, so a total spanning them needs conversion Insightly does not perform here.

endpoints.name: Custom Fields
endpoints.description: The custom fields defined on one object. Requires the object name. THE DECODER for custom values, which arrive keyed by field id on every standard object as well as custom ones.

endpoints.name: Custom Field
endpoints.description: One custom field definition, searched within an object.

endpoints.name: Custom Objects
endpoints.description: The custom objects defined on the account. INSIGHTLY LETS AN ACCOUNT DEFINE ITS OWN RECORD TYPES, so this is the first request whenever a question involves anything beyond the standard objects -- what exists is entirely account-specific.

endpoints.name: Custom Object
endpoints.description: One custom object's definition by name, with its fields.

endpoints.name: Custom Object Records
endpoints.description: The records of one custom object. Requires the object name. The data behind a user-defined record type.

endpoints.name: Custom Object Record
endpoints.description: One custom object record by id.

endpoints.name: Filtered Custom Object Records
endpoints.description: Custom object records matching field criteria.

endpoints.name: Events
endpoints.description: The calendar events -- meetings and appointments -- with title, times, location and attendees. The activity record beside tasks.

endpoints.name: Leads
endpoints.description: The unqualified prospects, with name, company, contact details, status, source, owner and custom fields. IN INSIGHTLY A LEAD IS CONVERTED into a contact, organisation and opportunity, and the lead record survives -- so leads and contacts hold different stages of the same people and counting both double-counts anyone converted.

endpoints.description: The revenue opportunities, with name, value and currency, the pipeline and stage, probability, forecast and actual close dates, state, and the organisation and contacts involved. The pipeline table. STATE separates Open from Won, Lost, Suspended and Abandoned, so a win rate has a specific denominator and an unfiltered value total is not a forecast.
